layers.process: Hainan has its own visa-free entry policy. Ordinary passport holders from 61 countries, Australia among them, can enter through any open port in Hainan and stay within Hainan Province for up to 30 days without a visa, for tourism, business, visits, family visits, medical treatment, conferences and exhibitions, or sports competitions. It doesn't cover work or study, and the stay is limited to Hainan's administrative region. The NIA notes that the Chinese version of visa policy prevails if versions differ.

laws.rule: Haikou: setting off fireworks is banned north of the Ring Expressway and Provincial Road 212 and in other zones set by the city (article 6). It is also banned at listed places including schools, hospitals, stations, markets, forests and scenic areas (article 7). Elsewhere it is allowed only on Lunar New Year's Eve and the first day of the new year, and from 6 am to 10 pm on other days (article 8).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 100 to 500 (about A$21.33 to A$107) (article 16). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
